title: GL passed a draft it never read because the draft path did not exist

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project against the live indexes

observed_failure: run_workflow.py passed --draft drafts/v002/paper.md, as its own usage line writes it, to tools running from the project root. Lint and number checks failed on the missing file, but GL skipped draft checks for a path that did not exist and reported PASSED.
expected_behavior: A draft path is found from the working directory or from .rcs/, a path that is neither stops run_workflow before any tool runs, and GL fails with DRAFT_MISSING when --draft names no file.

resolution.summary: run_workflow resolves draft paths and stops on a missing one; GL errors on a missing draft

lessons: A gate that skips its input when the input is missing must fail, not pass.
